create_graph: create a gtn Graph object with a specified symbolism flag for building finite-state transducers
add_node: add a node to the graph with optional start and final state boolean flags
add_arc: add an arc between two nodes in the graph with a given symbol label
draw_graph: draw and export a gtn graph to a PDF file with symbol and weight labels
union_graphs: union multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph recognizing all their languages
